title: Bunny Hop 4
author: louisng114
rules:
You can play the puzzle on the CtC app HERE.

Hop the bunny leapt into the Somedoku Dimension and got surrounded by equal-sum lasers! Help Hop avoid danger and return home!

Normal 6x6 sudoku rules DO NOT apply.

6x6 Somedoku:

Each cell contains one of the digits from 0-5. Every Nth row and every Nth column each contains N unique digits with the remaining ones being duplicates. For example, row 3 can be 400140, using the digits 0, 1, and 4.

BUNNY HOP:

Hop the bunny must reach the hole by visiting a series of cells. Hop jumps orthogonally by a number of cells exactly equal to the digit Hop is currently on. For example, if Hop jumped to R2C2, and R2C2 contains a 3, then Hop has to jump to R2C5 or R5C2. Hop does not land on the same cell twice.

BLACKCURRANTS:

Cells connected by a blackcurrant have a 1:2 ratio (one is double the other). Not all possible blackcurrants are necessarily given.

PATH OF SAFETY:

Each jump must cross at least one blue line. Each jump (including the digits Hop jumps from and lands on) form a valid region sum line, i.e. the blue lines separates the jump into parts that each sum to the same number. For example, if Hop jumps from R2C5 to R6C5, then R2C5 = R3C5 + R4C5 = R5C5 + R6C5.
solutionCode: Digits in row 5, then the digits in column 5. (12 digits with no space nor punctuation)
